Consent to prepare a human-review brief

turns_before_attempt.content: Hi, I'm the AIowa Service Guide, an AI assistant. What would you like help with?

Hi, Libby, I run Copper Mesa Supply, a plumbing supply business. We have 6 staff handling quote requests by email and they copy the details into Excel. Sometimes requests get missed and just curious how you guys could help us out on that.

I can help with that. AIowa Agents can automate repetitive workflows like processing incoming requests and organizing the details into a structured format, which could reduce the chance of missed quotes. I don't have approved information confirming whether your specific email and Excel setup is supported, so that would need a human review. Would you like me to prepare a brief for the team to look into?

Sure. Um, what we'd like is incoming emails turned into draft quotes with a person reviewing every quote before anything goes out. And uh, we use Outlook and Excel. Budget and timing are still unknown.

Got it. So you'd like incoming emails automatically turned into draft quotes, with a person reviewing each one before it goes out, using Outlook and Excel. That's a clear workflow to have the team look into. I can prepare a brief with those details for owner review. Would you like me to do that?
Yeah, but uh there's one correction. 4 staff handle those requests, not 6. And we also use a supplier portal, but I don't know whether it has an API.
